links.comparator_used: Historical pre-AI standard of care without automatic notification of AAA detections
links.outcome: Initial AAA evaluation after incidental detection (primary outcome)
links.effect: 42% vs 18% initial evaluation, P < 0.001; time to evaluation 22 vs 83 days, P = 0.1 (trend only)
links.quote: A greater proportion of patients underwent initial AAA evaluation after implementation of AI-assisted AAA care (42% vs. 18%, P < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: Historical pre-AI standard of care (pre-AI group) without the AI-linked referral and evaluation workflow
links.outcome: Long-term AAA follow-up and scheduled monitoring appointments
links.effect: Long-term follow-up 45% vs 30%, P = 0.004; scheduled monitoring appointments 99% vs 65%, P < 0.001
links.quote: The implementation of the AI-assisted AAA detection and care protocol significantly increased proportion of patients receiving initial AAA evaluation and long-term follow-up care.

design_hint: AI-triggered notifications with care-team workflow and referral protocol
